request_outcomes: Every format request of the session returned 200: profiles, overlays, plan, render, validation, review packet, review, candidate, preview, promotion.
coverage_limits: One blind reviewer (the sponsor), by sponsor decision on 2026-10-14; the spec asks for at least two, so material disagreement cannot arise.
Blindness is limited: the reviewer authored the plan in the same session, and the projection has the 9:16 target shape while the source is 16:9, so the shape reveals which clip is the projection.
One source master, one profile (vertical 9:16) and one reframe kind (PAD) were reviewed; COVER_CENTER, FOCAL_CROP and the 1:1 profile were not reviewed by a human.
The review note is empty; the evidence is the per-item verdicts only.
No live provider call is involved; the render is local FFmpeg.
